# `tfctl profile profiles delete`

The `tfctl profile profiles delete` command deletes an existing configuration profile.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile profiles delete PROFILE_NAMES [PROFILE_NAMES ...] [options]
```

## Description

The `tfctl profile profiles delete` command deletes an existing configuration profile. If the profile is the active profile, it may not be deleted.

To delete the current active profile, first run `tfctl profile profiles activate` to activate a different profile.

You can delete multiple profiles in a single command by providing multiple profile names.

## Arguments

- `PROFILE_NAMES [PROFILE_NAMES ...]`: (Required) The name(s) of the profile(s) to delete. May not be the active profile.

## Available options

The `tfctl profile profiles delete` command does not accept any command-specific options.

### Global flags

Refer to [Global flags reference](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli#global-flags) for information about flags you can use with all commands.

## Examples

The following examples demonstrate how to delete an existing configuration profile.

### Delete a profile

The following example deletes a profile by name. Replace `<PROFILE_NAME>` with the name of the profile to delete.

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile profiles delete <PROFILE_NAME>
```

### Delete the active profile

You cannot delete the currently active profile. The following example shows how to first activate a different profile, then delete the original profile. Replace `<PROFILE_NAME>` with the name of a new profile to activate, and `<OLD_PROFILE_NAME>` with the name of the profile to delete.

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile profiles activate <PROFILE_NAME>
```

Then, delete the other profile:

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile profiles delete <OLD_PROFILE_NAME>
```
